about: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare services in India. It operates through Healthcare Services, Retail Health & Diagnostics, Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution, and Others segments. The company's healthcare facilities comprise primary, secondary, and tertiary care, as well as specialty facilities.
